shortDescription: Manages Layer 2 switchport interfaces on HUAWEI CloudEngine switches.

options.name: default_vlan
options.description: If C(mode=access, or mode=dot1qtunnel), used as the access VLAN ID, in the range from 1 to 4094.

options.name: interface
options.description: Full name of the interface, i.e. 40GE1/0/22.

options.name: mode
options.description: The link type of an interface.

options.name: pvid_vlan
options.description: If C(mode=trunk, or mode=hybrid), used as the trunk native VLAN ID, in the range from 1 to 4094.

options.name: state
options.description: Manage the state of the resource.

options.name: tagged_vlans
options.description: If C(mode=hybrid), used as the VLAN range to ADD or REMOVE from the trunk, such as 2-10 or 2,5,10-15, etc.

options.name: trunk_vlans
options.description: If C(mode=trunk), used as the VLAN range to ADD or REMOVE from the trunk, such as 2-10 or 2,5,10-15, etc.

options.name: untagged_vlans
options.description: If C(mode=hybrid), used as the VLAN range to ADD or REMOVE from the trunk, such as 2-10 or 2,5,10-15, etc.
